subject: Just Flix Medford Funding Request
overview: The council discussed a grant proposal for a student documentary project and planned the annual grantee reception, though no official votes were taken due to a lack of quorum. Members also reviewed progress on the poet laureate search and designs for council-branded promotional merchandise.

items.title: Just Flix Medford Presentation
items.summary: Kate from the Mystic Project presented a proposal for student-led social justice short films requesting $2,000 for administrative and screening costs at the library and Chevalier Theatre.

items.title: Communications and Blog Updates
items.summary: The council discussed upcoming blog posts featuring a new mural at the Medford Arts Collaborative and the status of the council's newsletter.

items.title: Grantee Reception Planning
items.summary: Members agreed to hold the annual grantee reception on October 19 at Real Gusto, citing the venue's successful layout for previous events.

items.title: Local Cultural Events
items.summary: The council shared announcements for community events including PorchFest, Pride Month celebrations, and a pride flag raising at City Hall.

items.title: Poet Laureate Selection Update
items.summary: The selection committee narrowed the pool of applicants to two finalists who will submit recordings for a final evaluation.

items.title: Council Promotional Merchandise
items.summary: Members reviewed design mock-ups and colors for council t-shirts and stickers, discussing quotes from local Medford and Somerville printers.

items.title: Administrative Recognition
items.summary: The council discussed providing a gift for a member currently on maternity leave.
